title: docs: close out the #13564 family under ADR-0131; supersede #13636; the tenancy docs state the three sentences
body:
**⛔ BLOCKED — the v18 development line is not open.**

`Blocked-by: #15193, #15212, objectstack-ai/cloud#1979`

Part of #15194 (ADR-0131 execution tree). ⛔ Do not claim, assign or dispatch this card while #15193 is open.

---

**In one sentence.** Close the card family that produced ADR-0131, and make the tenancy documentation say the record's three sentences instead of describing the mechanism it replaced.

**Scope.** Rule **#13564** by pointer to ADR-0131 — the two read-side ledgers stay as the inventory's provenance, they are not deleted. Close **#13636** as superseded, with a comment pointing at ADR-0131 §1.6, and leave **PR #14923** unmerged with the same pointer (the "declare an organization-less write" alternative is rejected in §5). Answer **#11611** in the tenancy documentation. Record **#10103**'s warn-not-reap posture as superseded by C7's ceremony. Update the `content/docs` tenancy and permissions pages and the driver docblock to state the three sentences:

1. A managed package's metadata is not in the database; its definitions are sealed; customization is environment-level state.
2. A row with an organization column was written by that organization; the column is `NOT NULL`; references to declared items are by machine name.
3. A table with no organization column is deployment-level or code-level, protected by permissions rather than by the wall.

⛔ `content/docs/releases/` is **not** touched by this card. Release notes are written centrally at release time; the v18 upgrade ceremony's prominence there (D10) is the release writer's input, delivered as this line's changesets — not as a row appended per PR.

Refs: ADR-0131 (all decisions) · #13564 · #13636 · PR #14923 · #11611 · #10103.
